plugins.cameraPermission: Docket uses the camera to photograph your signed bill of lading, so it can read the in and out times. The photo isn't saved.
plugins.photosPermission: Docket lets you pick a photo of your bill of lading, so it can read the in and out times. The photo isn't saved.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Docket notices when you pull into and leave the stops on your load, so it can time your detention. Location stays on your phone and is never shared with your company.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Choose Always Allow so Docket can start and stop your detention clock at the stops on your load, even when the app is closed. Location stays on your phone and is never shared with your company.
